reason: The next tool call after the observed final native outcome must be CUA completion_summary alone; no intervening external timestamp tool can run.
receipt_method: Actor may record conditional filesystem completion markers after each observation and before planned Quit. Pair only the final applicable marker with the one immediate completion_summary return. Earlier markers remain unpaired conditional bookkeeping, never counted as attempted summary calls.
timing_qualification: Conditional marker is a conservative lower bound preceding summary invocation; external returned receipt is an upper bound. Do not call these exact summary invocation timestamps or a native controller pair. Native/external operation trace pairs remain exact.
counts_and_caps: Exactly one actual completion CUA call, separately reserved outside native trace counter; no new observer or procedure. Keep total<=176 and conservative elapsed upper bound through summary return<=1200 seconds from original case clock. Bookkeeping markers do not introduce additional target operations.
mandatory_order: Any unexpected outcome: very next tool call CUA completion_summary only, once. On success planned quit is last native observer, then next tool call same completion-only rule. No corrective action/quit/extra capture on failure.
